newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Airlines August load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Airlines August load factor up.

text.p: Mesaba Holdings Inc's Mesaba Airlines unit said its passenger load factor rose to 57.6 percent in August from 48.9 percent a year ago.
Available seat miles in the month were 74.0 million, up from 62.8 million a year ago, while revenue passenger miles were 42.7 million, up from 30.8 million a year ago, the company said.

Year-to-date load factor was 54.9 percent, with 342.2 million available seat miles and 187.8 revenue passenger miles, the company said. Comparable figures for 1995 were not immediately available, the company said.
